# Precepts

> Multi-discipline standards platform. Machine-readable standards for humans and AI agents.
> Standards are published as Markdown with YAML frontmatter, consumable by agents via MCP, llms.txt, and CLAUDE.md.

## Schema

Identifier pattern: [INTG|PRD|PRJ|UX|SEC]-[STD|GDL|GOV|BP]-NNN
Status values: DRAFT, MANDATORY, RECOMMENDED, DEPRECATED
Document types: standard, guideline, governance, best-practice
Domains: INTEGRATION, PRODUCT-MANAGEMENT, PROJECT-MANAGEMENT, UX, SECURITY
Version: semver (patch = typo fix, minor = new fields/status change, major = breaking)

## Disciplines

- [Integration Standards](https://docs.precepts.dev/integration/): API design, events, resilience, observability, data formats, naming, encoding, versioning
- [Product Management](https://docs.precepts.dev/product/): Requirements, roadmapping, prioritization guidelines
- [UX Standards](https://docs.precepts.dev/ux/): Accessibility, design systems, interaction patterns
- [Project Management](https://docs.precepts.dev/project-management/): Ceremonies, estimation, delivery practices

## Integration Standards (Published)

- [INTG-STD-004 Naming Conventions](https://docs.precepts.dev/integration/standards/foundational/naming-conventions): Rules for naming APIs, events, fields, and services across all integration boundaries
- [INTG-STD-005 Character Encoding](https://docs.precepts.dev/integration/standards/data-formats/character-encoding): UTF-8 as the mandatory encoding for all integration payloads
- [INTG-STD-006 Backward & Forward Compatibility](https://docs.precepts.dev/integration/standards/versioning/backward-forward-compatibility): Non-breaking change rules, deprecation windows, consumer compatibility guarantees
- [INTG-STD-008 API Resource Design](https://docs.precepts.dev/integration/standards/api/resource-design): REST resource modeling, URL structure, HTTP method semantics
- [INTG-STD-009 Error Handling](https://docs.precepts.dev/integration/standards/api/error-handling): Standardized error response envelope, status codes, problem detail format
- [INTG-STD-015 CloudEvents Envelope](https://docs.precepts.dev/integration/standards/events/event-envelope): CloudEvents 1.0-compliant event envelope for all domain events
- [INTG-STD-029 Integration Observability](https://docs.precepts.dev/integration/standards/observability/integration-observability): Logging, distributed tracing, and metrics standards for integration layers
- [INTG-STD-033 Resilience Patterns](https://docs.precepts.dev/integration/standards/resilience/integration-resilience-patterns): Circuit breaker, bulkhead, and fallback patterns for integration resilience
- [INTG-STD-034 Retry Policy](https://docs.precepts.dev/integration/standards/resilience/retry-policy): Exponential backoff, jitter, max-attempt, and idempotency requirements for retries
- [INTG-STD-035 Timeout](https://docs.precepts.dev/integration/standards/resilience/timeout): Connection, read, and write timeout standards per integration tier

## AI Distribution

Standards are delivered to AI agents via:
1. This file — AI crawler index at https://docs.precepts.dev/llms.txt
2. MCP Server — active querying via Model Context Protocol (see platform repo)
3. CLAUDE.md — auto-loaded context for Claude Code sessions in this repository
